'''Lady Dominique''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who, along with [[Kanoth|Lord Kanoth]], become one of the leaders of the obscure Sith cult known as [[the Unmasked]].<ref name="Lady Dominique" />

==Biography==
An apprentice to [[Renning|Lord Renning]] alongside [[Darth Malora|Malora]], she was constantly overshadowed by Malora, who she came to see as a rival. Once Malora gained a seat on the [[Dark Council]], that rivalry came to an end. Still wanting to overshadow Malora, Dominique came to work with [[Kanoth|Lord Kanoth]] and his protégé, [[Valeo|Lord Valeo]], in scouring the galaxy looking for ways to advance the field of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]], and together the group formed a secret cult called [[the Unmasked]] who were dedicated to the legacy of [[Darth Nihilus]], hoping to recreate the accident which turned him into a [[Wound in the Force/Legends|wound in the Force]].<ref name="The Unmasked: Ambitious Beginnings">{{TORcite|The Unmasked: Ambitious Beginnings|type=codex|exp=lots}}</ref> However, with most Sith scientific resources being diverted to Malora's experiments on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], Dominique continued to be overlooked. Eventually, she discovered an [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|AI]] called [[ARIA (AI)|ARIA]], who brokered a deal with Dominique; If Dominique would conceal the AI's existence, then ARIA would provide Dominique with research files on gravitational anomalies. Dominique agreed, and took these files to Kanoth, who was searching for the [[Mass Shadow Generator/Legends|Mass Shadow Generator]] and recognised the gravitational anomalies in [[sector R-4]] as belonging to the Mass Shadow Generator.<ref name="Lord Kanoth">{{TORcite|Lord Kanoth|type=codex|exp=lots}}</ref> Building a [[Unmasked research station|research station]], they attempted to rebuild the Mass Shadow Generator, however when the research wasn't going fast enough, Dominique attempted to merge with an AI called [[EVE]], and succeeded, but turned the entire research station into one giant hivemind as a result.<ref name="The Unmasked: A Dark Experiment">{{TORcite|The Unmasked: A Dark Experiment|type=codex|exp=lots}}</ref> During the [[Mission to the R-4 anomaly]], Dominique was killed by the [[Alliance Commander]], who also slew Kanoth and destroyed the station.<ref name="operation">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=operation|R-4 Anomaly}}</ref>
